title: Extract row-to-message deserialization helper in kith-store
description: MessageStore::get() and list_by_chat() both use identical query_map patterns to extract 11 fields into tuples (lines 128-142 and 202-216). The subsequent destructuring and timestamp-conversion logic is also duplicated (lines 149-167 vs 222-240). Extract a fn row_to_message() helper like the existing row_to_attachment() pattern in attachment.rs to eliminate the duplication.
